content:
Guys i found a new start-up today 😎

Mujhe lagta hai mere body mein bohot saari dryness hai 💀

Ear se wax ki jagah white flakes nikal rahe 
Baalo mein se bade bade white flakes aa rahe 
Garmiyo mein bhi skin dry ho rahi hai 

Ab lagta hai 2-3 din mein nabhi mein se bhi roei nikalna shuru ho jayegi 
aur fir mere ghar wale cotton beds ka business karenge 😭

Unko profitable business ke liye ab cow ki zarurat bhi nahi padegi 
kyuki cotton wala maal toh mast chalega 👀
